stages.name: dual_substrate_kinetics

stages.name: phbv_polymer_accumulation

stages.name: monomer_fraction_and_nanofiller_dispersion

stages.name: valerate_toxicity_trip
stages.details: Valerate toxicity trip 0xF921 asserted on S2 > 5.0 g/L; precursor feed shut off (%M600=False).

stages.name: nanofiller_agglomeration_trip
stages.details: Nanofiller agglomeration trip 0xF922 asserted on Phi_nano < 0.20; clumping alarm active.

stages.name: thermal_and_aeration_safety_trips
stages.details: Thermal runaway (0xF923), DO starvation (0xF924), and fault hierarchy verified.

stages.name: horner_ocs_registers_and_pure_st_pou
